item.title: Brooks Koepka returns to PGA Tour under stiff financial penalty just 5 weeks after leaving LIV
item.description: Brooks Koepka is returning to the PGA Tour just five weeks after bolting from LIV Golf, agreeing to a one-time program for elite players that comes with a financial penalty that could rank among the largest in sports. The post Brooks Koepka returns to PGA Tour under stiff financial penalty just 5 weeks after leaving LIV appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Sheriff Whittle looks back on deadly stop & debunks ATF-waiting narrative
